description: Expands the Benjolin Oscillator with eight rungler gate outputs; place it immediately to the right of the oscillator, or in an unbroken chain of expanders running right from it

params.text: Shapes every gate output: a gate while the logic is true, that gate only while the rungler clock is high or only while low, or a 1ms trigger as the logic goes true, on a clock rise, fall or edge
Picks the gate voltages: unipolar, 0V low and 10V high, or bipolar, -5V low and 5V high

outputs.text: A gate driven by the rungler bits picked in its right-click menu and combined with AND, OR or XOR; by default it follows the single bit matching its number, and the label above shows the logic

notes: the gate outputs are computed at the sample rate, so oversampling on the Benjolin Oscillator does not reach them
menu: Preset — four factory presets set all eight outputs at once: ALL Bits gives one gate per rungler bit, and AND Gates, OR Gates and XOR Gates combine bits
Gate bits, in an output's own port menu — which of the eight rungler bits that output reads, up to four of them at once
Gate logic, in an output's own port menu — AND, OR or XOR, the operation combining the bits picked for that output
